items.title: MC1566260: Video creation from a prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp: now in Video Hub, with an upgraded experience coming
items.summary: Microsoft Clipchamp's prompt-to-video feature is now in Video Hub. By February 2027, an upgraded version with better quality and fixes will replace it, available to current subscribers. Existing projects remain accessible, no admin action is needed, and users can refer to the provided support article.

items.title: MC1559644: [Education] AI-powered teaching tools in OneNote Class Notebook
items.summary: AI-powered Copilot teaching tools in OneNote Class Notebook help educators create personalized resources and interactive activities. Rolling out globally from mid-November to December 2026, these tools require no extra license and are managed via Copilot and Learning Activities settings. Educators should review…

items.title: MC1530595: Microsoft Copilot Feedback UX update
items.summary: Microsoft Copilot is updating its thumbs-down feedback to include selectable categories and optional comments for clearer, actionable input. The rollout starts mid-November 2026, completing by early December, affecting users with Microsoft Entra ID and consumer accounts, excluding some environments. No admin action is…

items.title: MC1565967: New VDI solution for Omnissa on Mac
items.summary: A new VDI optimization for Omnissa on Mac using a SlimCore-based media engine will enhance Microsoft Teams' quality, reliability, and performance. Rollout starts December 2026 to February 2027. Upgrade Horizon Client (2609.1+) and Teams (26304.1207.5384.858+) to benefit. No compliance issues noted.

items.title: MC1565964: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Classic publishing restrictions begin March 1, 2027
items.summary: Starting March 1, 2027, SharePoint Online will block creation and activation of classic publishing sites and features, enforcing restrictions on custom scripting. New tenants face additional limits on classic pages. Administrators must update workflows and modernize pages before the rollout completes by October 2028.

items.title: MC1565960: Plan for Change: Updates to policy-related reporting in Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse
items.summary: Starting January 4, 2027, Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse will update policy-related reporting collections, possibly causing changes in policy-status counts. Existing connections and schemas remain unchanged, and no action is required. Differences from Intune admin center reports may occur due to timing and…

items.title: MC1565959: Plan for Change: Updated web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS
items.summary: Microsoft Intune will update the web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS in late January 2027, affecting only tenants using this method. No admin action is needed, but user guidance may be updated. This change precedes web-based enrollment becoming the default for iOS/iPadOS.

items.title: MC1472601: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will enable admins to archive inactive SharePoint files under retention policies starting mid-January 2027. Archived files move to Microsoft 365 Archive, remain compliant and discoverable, and are excluded from Copilot indexing to improve response relevance. Admin…

items.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive SharePoint files to Microsoft 365 Archive for cost savings while maintaining compliance and discoverability. Archived content is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026…

items.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
items.summary: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow allowing admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, overriding retention policies with eDiscovery admin approval. Rolling out mid-August 2026 (preview) and early December 2026 (general availability), this feature requires explicit admin…

items.title: MC1550542: Microsoft Teams: Updated recording and transcript access setting behavior for town halls and webinars
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is updating the "Who has access to the recording or transcript" option for Events App town halls and webinars. Starting mid-January 2027, access will depend on the RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar settings, not AllowCloudRecording. No action is required.

items.title: MC1552394: Microsoft Viva Engage: Retiring the legacy live event creation option in Engage
items.summary: Starting December 7, 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will retire the legacy live event creation option. Organizers can no longer create legacy events but can still use Broadcast, Meeting, and Async Engage events. Existing legacy events will run as planned. Update organizers and documentation accordingly.

items.title: MC1519855: Microsoft Entra: Choose your own telephony provider now generally available
items.summary: Microsoft Entra now generally supports Choose Your Own Telephony Provider (CYOT) and Bring Your Own Telephony Provider (BYOT) for SMS and voice authentication. Microsoft-provided SMS/voice retires February 1, 2027. Organizations must transition by then, prioritizing phishing-resistant methods and using telephony only…

items.title: MC1093912: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: Improved Contacts with profile enrichment and duplicate management
items.summary: Microsoft Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android) will unify duplicate contacts and enrich profiles with organizational info, improving contact views. The rollout starts mid-July 2025 and completes by March 2027, with no admin action needed. Users should update to the latest app version after rollout.

items.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
items.summary: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by September-December 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption; hybrid/on-premises scenarios have separate…

items.title: MC1557760: Microsoft Teams: Registration capacity for town halls and webinars increases to 20,000
items.summary: Starting December 2026, Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars registration capacity scales with attendee limits, up to 20,000 registrations per event. Teams Enterprise allows 3,000; Attendee Capacity Packs allow up to 20,000. Rollout occurs from mid-December 2026 to late January 2027. No action required.

items.title: MC1562279: Microsoft Teams: View files and conversations side by side
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will enable side-by-side viewing of files (PDF, Markdown, HTML) and their related conversations, enhancing context during review. This feature will roll out worldwide from late December 2026 to early January 2027 on Windows, Mac, and web, requiring no admin action.

items.title: MC1562278: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in the compose box
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will launch an expanded Markdown compose experience in early December 2026, allowing users to write with visible Markdown syntax, use a dedicated toolbar, preview messages before sending, and switch between Markdown and rich text. No admin action is needed.

items.title: MC1562277: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in channels provides channel-wide context
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is adding a channel-level Copilot feature allowing users to ask questions and summarize all posts and replies in a channel. Public preview starts December 2026 worldwide, with no action required. Copilot responses will include source citations and be available on Teams desktop and mobile.

items.title: MC1562275: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: New search experience for Microsoft 365 users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license
items.summary: Microsoft 365 is updating the Copilot app's search experience for users without a Copilot license, enabling modern search controls by default starting late November 2026. Users can toggle back to classic search. The update improves file and third-party content search while respecting access permissions.

items.title: MC1562272: New Contact Support Experience in Outlook for iOS, Android and Mac
items.summary: A new Contact Support experience is rolling out in Outlook for iOS, Android, and Mac, aligning with the new Outlook for Windows. It uses the existing policy "Allow access to Contact Support in the new Outlook." Rollout starts late November 2026, completing by January 2027. No new policy needed; admins with disabled…

items.title: MC1562269: Sync between Copilot desktop app and Microsoft Edge
items.summary: Optional sync of passwords, personal info, settings, and browsing history between Copilot desktop app and Microsoft Edge will roll out worldwide in December 2026. Sync is account-based, opt-in, excludes payment info, and aims to improve user continuity and organizational productivity. Review governance before enabling.

items.title: MC1230457: Moderation approvals now available across Outlook apps
items.summary: Moderation approvals in Exchange Online will use Actionable Messages adaptive cards across all Outlook clients starting March 2026, completing by November 2026. Dual-mode approvals end July 31, 2026. Moderators must have Microsoft 365 mailboxes. Actionable Messages must be enabled to prepare for this update.

items.title: MC1559642: Continuous interpreter visibility with pop out video in Teams
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to pop out sign language interpreters' videos into a resizable, movable window for continuous visibility during meetings. Rolling out from December 2026 to January 2027 on Windows and Mac, this feature aids Deaf and hard-of-hearing users without affecting other participants' views.

items.title: MC1515303: Power Apps - Information regarding the end of support for Power Apps Developer Plan and unmanaged developer environments
items.summary: The free Power Apps Developer Plan is being retired. As this plan works only in unmanaged developer environments, these environments are also being retired. Beginning with a regional rollout starting November 15, 2026, users will no longer be able to sign up for the plan or create new unmanaged developer environments…

items.title: MC1515294: Power Apps – Feature retirement of Microsoft Dataverse for Teams: migrate before September 15, 2027
items.summary: We are announcing the retirement of Microsoft Dataverse for Teams, the built-in subset of Dataverse capabilities in Microsoft Teams. Beginning with a regional rollout on November 15, 2026, customers will no longer be able to create new Dataverse for Teams environments. Existing Dataverse for Teams environments will…

items.title: MC1545694: Microsoft Entra: Updated passkey registration experience in My Sign-ins
items.summary: Microsoft Entra is updating the passkey registration in My Sign-ins for Microsoft Authenticator users, adding a checkbox, updated link text, and guided steps to start registration. Rollout begins early December 2026, completing by end of December. Organizations should inform users and update guidance accordingly.

items.title: MC1540327: Action required: Prepare users who can’t use passkeys for SMS and voice retirement
items.summary: Users relying solely on Microsoft-provided SMS/voice for MFA in sessions that don’t support passkeys must register alternative methods or configure customer-managed telephony before SMS/voice retirement begins February 1, 2027 (July 1 for admins/external users). Prepare early to avoid sign-in blocks.

items.title: MC1557754: Microsoft Copilot: Continue using models after reaching usage limits with Copilot Credits
items.summary: Microsoft Copilot now allows continued use of models after license usage limits via usage-based billing (UBB) with Copilot Credits. Users see credit indicators and can choose between Auto mode or credit-consuming models. Admins manage access and spending through updated policies and controls. Rollout begins December…

items.title: MC1535647: Microsoft Copilot app: Updates to Home and navigation
items.summary: Microsoft Copilot app updates include a new Home with integrated Chat, Cowork, Projects, and Workspaces. Projects organize related tasks and files without storing content, available on major platforms. Workspaces replace Notebooks for team collaboration. Rollout starts late October 2026; licensing and billing…

items.summary: We are announcing the ability to generate documents from the Agent node in workflows within Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 3, 2026. items.summary: Starting April 1, 2027, SharePoint temporary authentication URLs will no longer be available. Power Apps and Automate functionality that relies on these URLs will break when they are retired. How does this affect me? items.summary: We are announcing the ability to create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent's user account in Copilot Studio. items.title: MC1560951: Low-latency alerts and metrics in Monitor
items.summary: We are announcing the ability to evaluate alert rules and review supported metrics for business-critical resources every hour in Monitor, helping admins identify potential issues sooner. This feature will enter public preview on November 23, 2026. How does this affect me? When creating or editing an alert rule for a…

items.title: MC1560957: Power Platform Monitor - Route alert notifications to connector-backed destinations
items.summary: We are announcing the ability to route Power Platform Monitor alert notifications to Microsoft Teams, SMS, work item tracking systems, and other connector-backed destinations in Power Platform. items.title: MC1518034: Clipchamp/ Copilot 'Create a video' experience is going to have an admin control available
items.summary: Microsoft Clipchamp is adding an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI video creation feature, defaulting to disabled. The feature is now only available from Clipchamp Home. Rollout begins late November 2026, with no action needed to keep the feature disabled.

items.title: MC1560929: Updates to Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) for Admins in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) adds a workspace for admins to configure organizational data and context, improving AI-driven responses. Rolling out mid-November 2026 for Frontier tenants, it requires specific admin roles and licensing, with controls for data access, configuration, and…

items.title: MC1560924: Microsoft Teams: Tenant policy controls who can record and transcribe
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a tenant policy controlling who can record and transcribe meetings, allowing admins to set permissions for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters with options to lock or allow changes. Rollout begins December 2026, with no action required unless restricting presenter recording is…

items.title: MC1560923: Enhanced prompt categories for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Copilot Dashboard and Agent 365 Business Analytics
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces 13 enhanced prompt categories replacing four legacy ones in the Copilot Dashboard and Agent 365 Business Analytics. This update, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, offers detailed insights into Copilot Chat usage by licensed users, with no admin action needed.

items.title: MC1560922: Microsoft Copilot: In-app browsing will be enabled by default in the desktop app
items.summary: Microsoft Copilot desktop app will enable in-app browsing by default starting January 2027, allowing users to open websites shared in chat within the app alongside conversations. No action is needed unless organizations want to disable or manage this feature via policies.

items.title: MC1560920: Copilot video creation in Clipchamp Video Hub is now live in Frontier Public
items.summary: Copilot video creation in Clipchamp Video Hub is now in public preview, enabling users to create and refine videos from documents and prompts using Copilot Credits. Admins must enable Anthropic models and configure spending policies. Videos export as MP4 with an AI watermark, and some preview limitations apply.

items.title: MC1560919: Microsoft Teams mobile: Updated app bar and More menu on iOS and iPadOS
items.summary: Microsoft Teams for iOS/iPadOS will update the app bar and More menu to align with iOS 26 design, showing four apps plus a categorized More menu. Rollout is from December 10-16, 2026. Users can reorder and pin apps; no apps are removed. No action required.

items.title: MC1560916: Microsoft Copilot: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra rolling out
items.summary: Microsoft Copilot is expanding AI model options with GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, rolling out across Cowork, Copilot Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Chat. Astra requires enabling the OpenAI subprocessor. Users with appropriate licenses and configurations get default access; no action is needed but reviewing settings…

items.summary: Microsoft Teams is replacing the Copilot meeting policy with two policies—MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI—for clearer control over AI and transcription in meetings. Some users may need to complete CAPTCHA before receiving codes or calls. Organizations should prepare help desks, notify users, and ensure network readiness, while continuing to…

items.title: MC1560705: The November 2026 Windows non-security preview update is now available
items.summary: The November 2026 non-security preview update is now available for Windows 11, versions 26H2, 26H1, and 25H2. Information about the contents of this update is available in the release notes, which are accessible from the Windows 11 update history page. To learn more about the different types of monthly quality…

items.summary: Teams device management in the Teams Admin Center (TAC) will be deprecated by November 2026, transitioning to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal (PMP). items.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
items.summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is updating App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles with Unified RBAC support, rolling out December 2026. Cloud App Security Administrators gain policy management rights; Compliance Administrators and Compliance Data Administrators lose some permissions. Admins…

items.summary: We are announcing the ability to choose Decision models in Classify nodes within a workflow in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on November 19, 2026. How does this affect me? Makers can choose a decision model in the Classify node for more efficient, higher volume classification. You can…

items.title: MC1532259: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of Translate slides in PowerPoint Live
items.summary: Starting November 30, 2026, the Translate slides feature in PowerPoint Live during Microsoft Teams meetings will be retired worldwide. Attendees will no longer translate slides; slides will display in their original language. No admin action is needed, but organizations should notify users and update related training…

items.title: MC1518033: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. Rollout starts November 2026 (targeted) and general availability in March 2027. No admin action is needed, but team owners should be informed.

items.title: MC1540351: Microsoft Teams: Automatically add tag members to channels with Workflows
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Workflows app template to automatically add users to standard or shared channels when added to a team tag. Rollout starts November 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by March 2027 (General Availability). The feature is optional and requires team owner configuration.

items.title: MC796790: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
items.summary: Microsoft has unified app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Starting September 2025, availability unification occurs in phases, with installation unification generally available since November 2026, synchronizing settings within 24–48 hours after…

items.title: MC1559641: New Copilot experience in OneNote
items.summary: The new Copilot experience in OneNote enhances editing and reasoning across notes, ink, annotations, and files, enabling better information synthesis and content creation. Rollout starts November 2026 for Frontier Public and January 2027 worldwide on Windows and iPad; other platforms will follow later. No admin action…

items.title: MC1559638: New capabilities in Copilot Workspaces
items.summary: Copilot Notebooks is evolving into Copilot Workspaces with new collaboration features like activity feed, team presence, and group ownership. Rollout began November 2026 (Frontier Public) and worldwide availability starts December 2026. No immediate admin action is needed; update user guidance accordingly.

items.title: MC1559637: Microsoft Teams: Real-time queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing real-time call queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile, allowing calling representatives and supervisors to monitor queue activity and performance on the go. This rollout begins in December 2026, requires no admin action, and enhances visibility without changing queue management.

items.title: MC1559633: Microsoft SharePoint: Agent Chat web part to bring Copilot agents into SharePoint pages
items.summary: The Agent Chat web part lets SharePoint authors embed Microsoft 365 Copilot agents into pages for easier discovery and interaction. Rolling out from November 2026 to March 2027 worldwide, it requires no admin action. Permissions remain separate, and no compliance impact is expected.

items.title: MC1559632: Copilot Workspaces: Updated workspace memory
items.summary: Copilot in Workspaces now retains workspace memory to provide more relevant, consistent responses across sessions, improving productivity. Public Preview began November 2026; General Availability starts December 2026. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed of the update. No compliance issues…

items.title: MC1559628: Choose how your presenter view is laid out in PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams
items.summary: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams now lets presenters choose from four presenter view layouts to suit their style, without affecting attendees' view. This feature, available on Windows, Mac, and web, rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026 and requires no admin action.
